page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 230 at left and running title "LOCUS DECIMUS." centred. Below it a line of verse reference and a roman numeral signature XCIV. Then an ornamental rule, a full-width heading "LOCUS UNDECIMUS. DE FOEDERE GRATIAE." with "BREVIARIUM" spaced beneath, then one body text column of italic summary paragraph ending with a catchword-like word "bum" at the lower right. Faint marginal notes in the left margin are too faint to read and are not transcribed.
